fields.name: first_frame_url

fields.name: last_frame_url
fields.label: Last Frame Url
fields.description: URL of the last-frame image. Use together with first_frame_url. Same format limits as first_frame_url.

fields.name: reference_image_urls
fields.label: Reference Image Urls
fields.description: Reference images for the all-purpose reference mode, with up to 10 images. Correspond to Image1, Image2, … in the prompt according to array order. Specifications are the same as `first_frame_url`. Cannot be provided together with the first-frame/last-frame parameters.

fields.name: reference_video_urls
fields.label: Reference Video Urls
fields.description: Reference videos for the all-purpose reference mode, with up to 5 clips. Each clip must be 1–15 seconds, with a total duration ≤ 15 seconds. Correspond to Video1, Video2, … according to array order.

fields.name: reference_audio_urls
fields.label: Reference Audio Urls
fields.description: Reference audio for the all-purpose reference mode, with up to 5 clips. Each clip must be 1–15 seconds, with a total duration ≤ 15 seconds. fields.name: reference_file_urls
fields.label: Reference File Urls
fields.description: File-to-video generation. Up to 1 file. Cannot be provided together with `reference_link_urls`, or with the first-frame/last-frame parameters.

fields.name: reference_link_urls
fields.label: Reference Link Urls
fields.description: Link-to-video generation. Up to 1 publicly accessible webpage that does not require login. Cannot be provided together with `reference_file_urls`, or with the first-frame/last-frame parameters.
